tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Young Grim Taken Psion Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Grim Taken Psion Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Grim Taken Psion Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Grim Taken Psion Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Grim Taken Psion Minor
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Grim Taken Psion Minor bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Grim Taken Psion Minor
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Grim Taken Psion Minor — Nova Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nova path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Grim Taken Psion Minor is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_6.name: Grim Taken Psion Minor the True
star_6.appearance: Grim Taken Psion Minor now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Grim Taken Psion Minors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Cosmic Drift Crystal

star_7.name: Sublime Grim Taken Psion Minor
star_7.appearance: The final form. Grim Taken Psion Minor stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Grim Taken Psion Minor is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Horizon" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Newborn Sunken Cabal Legionary
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sunken Cabal Legionary. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Sunken Cabal Legionarys in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Sunken Cabal Legionary
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Sunken Cabal Legionary
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Sunken Cabal Legionary bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Sunken Cabal Legionary
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Spawn Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Sewer Alien Rat Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted — Nova Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nova path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted the First
star_6.appearance: Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Sewer Alien Rat Corrupteds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Cosmic Drift Crystal

star_7.name: Absolute Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted
star_7.appearance: The final form. Sewer Alien Rat Corrupted stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Space Pirate Warrior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Space Pirate Warrior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Space Pirate Warriors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Space Pirate Warrior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Newborn Husk Zombie Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Husk Zombie Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Husk Zombie Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Husk Zombie Blessed

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Bud Corrupt Geth Trooper

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Kindling Corrupt Geth Trooper

base_chain.name: First-Form Noxious Taken Knight Greater

tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Newborn Space Grub I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Space Grub I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Space Grub Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Space Grub I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Space Grub I
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Space Grub I bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Space Grub I
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Space Grub I — Nova Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nova path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Space Grub I is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Space Grub I of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Space Grub I now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Space Grub Is have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Cosmic Drift Crystal

star_7.name: God-King Space Grub I
star_7.appearance: The final form. Space Grub I stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Wisp Nemesis Reaper Capital Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nemesis Reaper Capital Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Nemesis Reaper Capital Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Nemesis Reaper Capital Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Weak Void Worm Cursed of the Abyss

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Digital Entity-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Recon Drone Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Recon Drone Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Recon Drone Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Recon Drone Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Wisp Eternal Sovereign Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Eternal Sovereign Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Eternal Sovereign Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Stirring Eternal Sovereign Fragment

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Fledgling Mud Void Worm Blessed

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Stellar Being-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Lesser Yellow Cosmic Grub Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Yellow Cosmic Grub Elite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Yellow Cosmic Grub Elites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Yellow Cosmic Grub Elite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.name: Pup Raging Fallen Captain
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Raging Fallen Captain. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Raging Fallen Captains in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Raging Fallen Captain

base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Lesser Warden Cabal Centurion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Warden Cabal Centurion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Warden Cabal Centurions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Warden Cabal Centurion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Warden Cabal Centurion
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Warden Cabal Centurion bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Newborn Void Worm

base_chain.name: Pup Quarried Reaper Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Quarried Reaper Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Quarried Reaper Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Quarried Reaper Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Marked Lunar Hive Wizard
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Lunar Hive Wizard — Nova Sovereign

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Lunar Hive Wizard is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Lunar Hive Wizard Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Lunar Hive Wizard now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Vex Hobgoblin Elite — Nova Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nova path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Vex Hobgoblin Elite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Vex Hobgoblin Elite of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Vex Hobgoblin Elite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Vex Hobgoblin Elites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Cosmic Drift Crystal

star_7.name: God-King Vex Hobgoblin Elite
star_7.appearance: The final form. Vex Hobgoblin Elite stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Bud Alien Grub I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Alien Grub I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Alien Grub Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Alien Grub I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Pup Wrathful Ghost Leviathan Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wrathful Ghost Leviathan Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Wrathful Ghost Leviathan Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Wrathful Ghost Leviathan Scout

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Pup Ember Necromorph Slasher
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ember Necromorph Slasher. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Ember Necromorph Slashers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Ember Necromorph Slasher

base_chain.name: Hatchling Commander Hive Champion

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Infernal-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Demon Fallen Captain
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Demon Fallen Captain. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Demon Fallen Captains in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Demon Fallen Captain
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Demon Fallen Captain
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Demon Fallen Captain bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Demon Fallen Captain
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

base_chain.name: Newborn Undying Metroid Prime Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Undying Metroid Prime Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Undying Metroid Prime Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Undying Metroid Prime Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Pup Rune Xenomorph Warrior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rune Xenomorph Warrior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Rune Xenomorph Warriors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Kindling Rune Xenomorph Warrior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Newborn Crimson Flood Infection Minor

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Crimson Flood Infection Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Crimson Flood Infection Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Young Plague Flood Combat Form
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague Flood Combat Form. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Plague Flood Combat Forms in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Plague Flood Combat Form
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Seed Scraggly Star Bat IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scraggly Star Bat IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Scraggly Star Bat IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Awakened Scraggly Star Bat IV

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Wild Metroid Larva Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Wild Metroid Larva Omega
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Wild Metroid Larva Omega
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Wild Metroid Larva Omega bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Wild Metroid Larva Omega
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

base_chain.name: Newborn Dire Star Mote
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dire Star Mote. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Dire Star Motes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Dire Star Mote
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Space Rat — Nova Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nova path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Space Rat is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Void Frontier. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Space Rat the Undying
star_6.appearance: Space Rat now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Space Rats have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Cosmic Drift Crystal

star_7.name: Legend Space Rat
star_7.appearance: The final form. Space Rat stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Space Rat is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Last Horizon" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Young Flood Infection Omega
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Flood Infection Omega. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Flood Infection Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Flood Infection Omega
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Stellar Being-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Pup Cosmic Grub VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cosmic Grub VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Cosmic Grub VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Cosmic Grub VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Cosmic Grub VII
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Cosmic Grub VII bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Wisp Hive Acolyte Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hive Acolyte Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Hive Acolyte Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Hive Acolyte Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Hive Acolyte Senior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Hive Acolyte Senior bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Warborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Lesser Juggernaut Hive Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Juggernaut Hive Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Juggernaut Hive Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: First-Form Juggernaut Hive Champion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Juggernaut Hive Champion

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Elemental-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Young Sunken Nebula Mote Beta
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sunken Nebula Mote Beta. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Sunken Nebula Mote Betas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Sunken Nebula Mote Beta
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Seed Ancient Harbinger Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ancient Harbinger Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Ancient Harbinger Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Ancient Harbinger Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Rust Cabal Phalanx VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Rust Cabal Phalanx VII

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Rust Cabal Phalanx VII

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nova Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_6.name: Void Bat Tamed the First
star_6.appearance: Void Bat Tamed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.

base_chain.name: Young Master Flood Pure Form
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Master Flood Pure Form. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Master Flood Pure Forms in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Master Flood Pure Form
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Giant-Kin-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Spawn Wrath Taken Ogre
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wrath Taken Ogre. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Wrath Taken Ogres in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Wrath Taken Ogre
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Wrath Taken Ogre
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Wrath Taken Ogre bears the aesthetic of Void Frontier — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Stellar crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the next horizon is the only horizon. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Wrath Taken Ogre
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Void Frontier-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nova Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Void Frontier, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Geth Trooper
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Geth Trooper. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Geth Troopers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Geth Trooper
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

lore_summary: A creature of the Void Frontier, aligned with Stellar energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Void Frontier. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Stellar tamers are called Navigators. Bond is formed through exploration — discovering 3 new Codex entries with the monster as companion.

base_chain.name: Lesser Celestial Predator Hunter
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Celestial Predator Hunter. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Void Frontier. Celestial Predator Hunters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Celestial Predator Hunter
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Stellar — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Void Frontier. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%
